description: Changes the name of a webinar, the title you see in the dashboard and in the list. Take it when the name itself is wrong or out of date. A host says: "Put 2026 into the title." It needs the session, the webinar and the new name. It writes on your site, moves the page title with it and updates the places in the copy where the title stands. The other texts are not rewritten, and the answer names those places. Before writing, read the current title with wi_get_webinar or wi_list_webinars and show the old and the new one as two blocks, line by line. When several places carry a title, show the candidates first and write after the host picked one. The answer carries the previous name, so the same call puts it back. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: rename a webinar, change the title, new name, title says old date

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

value.description: The new webinar name, as the host wants to read it in the list. Do not shorten it.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_title
title: Change the name of a webinar
